text_block_list.name: Horse Girls
text_block_list.text: —*sigh*, so beautiful...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Walking through campus one day, I noticed 
a group of horse girls staring entranced 
at a single spot. Curious, I followed 
their gaze...

text_block_list.name: Horse Girl A
text_block_list.text:
*sigh*... She's just reading a book, so 
why does it look like a masterpiece of a 
painting?

text_block_list.name: Horse Girl B
text_block_list.text:
Exquisitely beautiful, brilliant... and an 
incredible runner. Everyone admires her.

text_block_list.name: Horse Girl B
text_block_list.text:
Being utterly perfect in every way... It's 
like she's a work of art.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I took another look at Mejiro Ramonu. 
Completely paying no mind to the murmurs 
at a distance, eyes fixed upon her book, 
she was indeed mesmerizingly beautiful.
choice_data_list: (I see, a work of art indeed...)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—I happened to run into her again at an 
art museum. There was a special exhibition 
for artwork themed around races; 
presumably, it had piqued her interest as 
well.
choice_data_list_en: (I see, so it's a work of art...)

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, look at that horse girl. She's 
stunning...

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
...Whoa, I forgot to breathe! She's the 
most gorgeous thing here today...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
People were no longer looking at the 
artwork, but gazing spellbound at her. 
Wondering about the painting she had been 
staring at for quite some time, I walked 
closer...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It depicted a winged horse girl galloping 
freely across the vast sky. The 
brushstrokes were vibrant and lively—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: A dreadful painting.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Her pale violet eyes locked with mine. 
Yet, with a languid indifference as if 
merely glancing toward a noise, she began 
to look away... Spontaneously, I asked—
choice_data_list: Why do you think it's dreadful?
Why do you consider it dreadful?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
choice_data_list: どうしてひどい絵だと思うんだ？
どうしてひどい絵だと思うの？
choice_data_list_en: Why do you think it's a terrible drawing?
Why do you think it's a terrible drawing?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: Why do you find it beautiful?
choice_data_list:
Mention the emotions poured into the 
painting

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Meticulous brushwork, vivid use of color. 
Recreating even light with such exquisite 
precision, I genuinely thought the 
painting was lovely.
choice_data_list: 絵に込められた想いに触れる
choice_data_list_en: Mention the quality of the drawing
Mention the feelings poured into the picture

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: Is that so...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
Indeed, it is a pretty canvas. Truly 
academic, and quite ideal.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
Even the smile "she" wears is brimming 
with benevolence...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: However—that is all.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
...Ignorant, unenlightened, and utterly 
devoid of love.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
—Smugly convinced that goodness and beauty 
have said all there is to say.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro Ramonu's eyes flared with a sharp 
intensity. That chilling gaze left a 
deeper mark on me than anything else I saw 
that day...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
From the expression of the horse girl 
racing across the sky, one could feel the 
joy of "freedom." I found that underlying 
sentiment beautiful.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: Freedom.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: So that is how you see it.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
Rather, I sense an "unfreedom" shackled by 
imagination.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
If one truly knew real freedom, one would 
never dream of running through the sky.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
Even though this constraint itself is 
proof of love.
choice_data_list: Is that why it is a "dreadful painting"?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: Who can say... All I can tell you is—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
—It is smugly convinced that goodness and 
beauty have said all there is to say.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro Ramonu's eyes flared with a sharp 
intensity. That chilling gaze left a 
deeper mark on me than anything else I saw 
that day...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Frankly, I had no other answer. So when I 
answered honestly that it was just 
intuition...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: ...Fufu.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: Unpretentious, aren't you?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
Standing before me as I call it dreadful, 
yet boldly declaring your own sensibility 
without fawning.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: —Commendable.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: Though my answer remains unchanged.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: Because it lacks love. Besides...
choice_data_list: 君はなぜ“ひどい絵”だと？
貴方はなぜ“ひどい絵”だと？
choice_data_list_en: Why do you think it's an "awful drawing"?
Why do you think it's a 'terrible drawing'?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
—It is smugly convinced that goodness and 
beauty have said all there is to say.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro Ramonu's eyes flared with a sharp 
intensity. That chilling gaze left a 
deeper mark on me than anything else I saw 
that day...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Frankly, I had no other answer. So when I 
answered honestly that it was just 
intuition...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: ...I see.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
Sensibility varies from person to person, 
after all.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
Seeking reasons where words fail is fine. 
However...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
Words tossed out carelessly before 
exhausting one's thoughts cannot be called 
an answer.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
I have no desire to debate, so it hardly 
matters.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: Who can say... All I can tell you is—
choice_data_list: ちなみに“ひどい絵”の理由は……？
